description: FINAL: delete the entire deprecated block in lib/std/elf.sig and prove the end state. MUST be last — every consumer must already be converted (FEAT-001..005). Delete only /// Deprecated decls plus the explicitly-listed zero-consumer niche structs; re-point the surviving non-deprecated switch(@sizeOf) aliases at the ElfN.* twins; keep SHN_*/PF_X|W|R/DT_*/NT_*/VER_FLG_*/PN_XNUM and the top-level Auxv alias. Then run the full gate + all three DONE checks and write the APPROVED verdict only when every check is zero and green.
steps: Read A1-migration-spec.md step 11 + 12 and plan.md. In lib/std/elf.sig delete every decl whose doc-comment LITERALLY says /// Deprecated (97 markers): the SHT_*/STB_*/STT_*/STV_* int consts (~477-608), the EI_* consts (~1165-1177), the ELFCLASS*/ELFDATA* consts (~1804-1843), the scalar aliases Elf32_Xword/Sxword/Elf64_Xword/Sxword/Elf*_Addr/Off/Section (~1426-1444), the flat deprecated structs Elf32_Ehdr/Elf64_Ehdr/Elf*_Shdr/Elf*_Chdr/Elf*_Sym/Elf*_Rel/Elf*_Rela/Elf*_Dyn/Elf*_Verneed and their inline methods st_type/st_bind/r_sym/r_type (~1446-1640), and the /// Deprecated switch(@sizeOf) aliases Ehdr(~1744)/Chdr(~1775)/Sym(~1781)/Addr(~1787).

ALSO delete the niche zero-consumer structs (confirmed no in-tree consumers): Elf32_auxv_t/Elf64_auxv_t, Elf32_Nhdr/Elf64_Nhdr (top-level), Elf32_Move/Elf64_Move, Elf32_gptab, Elf32_RegInfo, Elf_Options/Elf_Options_Hw, Elf32_Lib/Elf64_Lib, Elf32_Conflict, Elf_MIPS_ABIFlags_v0, and any top-level Elf*_Syminfo/Elf*_Verneed left after the renames.

RE-POINT (do NOT delete) the NON-/// Deprecated switch(@sizeOf) aliases at the ElfN.* twins: `pub const Auxv = ElfN.Auxv;` (MUST survive — used by start.sig/os/linux.sig), and likewise Dyn/Rel/Rela/Relr/Shdr if they lack the /// Deprecated marker — point each at ElfN.* (e.g. `pub const Shdr = ElfN.Shdr;`). Verify by reading each alias's doc-comment: if it says /// Deprecated, delete; otherwise re-point.

KEEP: SHN_* (~not marked), PF_X/PF_W/PF_R, all DT_* comptime_ints, NT_*, VER_FLG_*, PN_XNUM, and every STAY item (Ident/Versym/VER_NDX/Verdef/Verdaux/Vernaux/CLASS/DATA/EM/ET/PT/SHT/STB/STT/STV/SHF/PF/COMPRESS/OSABI/EhdrFlags/gnu_hash/R_*/EI/MAGIC/Half/Word/Sword/Xword/Sxword/Section).
Run the full 3-layer gate; iterate until GATE: GREEN. The 12 internal self-use hits in elf.sig vanish with the deprecated-method deletion — confirm.

Run the three FINAL DONE checks over -g "*.sig" lib src tools and confirm each returns ZERO genuine hits (SuperH .sh_interrupt/.sh_gnu/.sh_renesas and non-.sig libc headers are the only acceptable leftovers for check 3/1 respectively — but with -g "*.sig" the libc headers are excluded, so checks 1 and 2 must be truly 0, and check 3 must be 0 after excluding the SuperH tags).

If possible, additionally run `sig test compiler/test_all.sig`; and if an sBPF artifact is available sanity-check `sig build-lib ... -target sbf-solana-solana` still emits a valid ET_DYN (confirms the byteSwap/serialization changes did not regress output). Note these may SKIP/be unavailable on this host — record the outcome in findings.
Commit all work locally on branch feat/sbpf-solana (do NOT push, do NOT amend, do NOT touch git config).
acceptance_criteria: `rg -g "*.sig" "\.(sh_|st_info|st_other|st_shndx|st_value|st_name|r_info|r_addend|d_tag|d_val)" lib src tools` shows only SuperH .sh_interrupt/.sh_gnu/.sh_renesas (zero genuine-ELF hits).
lib/std/elf.sig still exports `pub const Auxv = ElfN.Auxv;` and all KEEP items; no /// Deprecated decl remains.
verification: pwsh .agents/tasks/objdump-elf-disasm/gate.ps1  (confirm GATE: GREEN; or run the 3 commands separately)
rg -c -g "*.sig" "Elf(32|64)_[A-Za-z]" lib src tools  (expect no output)
rg -c -g "*.sig" "elf\.(SHT|SHF|STB|STT|STV|ELFCLASS|ELFDATA|EI)_[A-Z]" lib src tools  (expect no output)
rg -n -g "*.sig" "\.(sh_|st_info|st_other|st_shndx|st_value|st_name|r_info|r_addend|d_tag|d_val)" lib src tools  (expect only SuperH .sh_interrupt/.sh_gnu/.sh_renesas)
findings: APPROVED. Deleted the entire deprecated block in lib/std/elf.sig: all 97 /// Deprecated decls (SHT_*/STB_*/STT_* int consts, EI_* consts, ELFCLASS*/ELFDATA* consts, scalar aliases Elf32/64_Xword/Sxword/Addr/Off/Section, flat structs Elf32/64_Ehdr/Shdr/Chdr/Sym with st_type/st_bind, and the /// Deprecated switch(@sizeOf) aliases Ehdr/Chdr/Sym/Addr) PLUS the niche zero-consumer structs (Elf32/64_Syminfo top-level, Elf32/64_Rel/Rela/Relr/Dyn flat with r_sym/r_type, Elf32/64_Verneed top-level, Elf32/64_auxv_t, Elf32/64_Nhdr top-level, Elf32/64_Move, Elf32_gptab, Elf32_RegInfo, Elf_Options/Elf_Options_Hw, Elf32/64_Lib, Elf32_Conflict, Elf_MIPS_ABIFlags_v0). RE-POINTED the non-/// Deprecated switch(@sizeOf) aliases at the ElfN.* twins: Dyn/Rel/Rela/Relr/Shdr now `= ElfN.*`; the top-level `pub const Auxv = ElfN.Auxv;` survives. KEPT all STAY items (SHN_*, PF_X/W/R, DT_*, NT_*, VER_FLG_*, PN_XNUM, NT_GNU_BUILD_ID, Verdef/Verdaux/Vernaux, Ident/EI/CLASS/DATA/EM/ET/PT/SHT/STB/STT/STV/SHF/PF/COMPRESS/OSABI/EhdrFlags/gnu_hash/R_*/MAGIC/Half/Word/Sword/Xword/Sxword/Section and the Elf32/Elf64/ElfN namespaces incl. their Dyn/Relr/Nhdr/Syminfo/Verneed/Auxv twins). One consumer required conversion for the const deletion: src/link/Elf.sig writeElfHeader used elf.ELFCLASS32/64 and elf.ELFDATA2LSB/2MSB -> switched to @intFromEnum(elf.CLASS.@"32"/@"64") and @intFromEnum(elf.DATA.@"2LSB"/@"2MSB"). GATE: GREEN (layer 1 compiler-graph type-check clean; layer 2 `sig test lib/std/elf.sig` All 0 tests passed; layer 3 `sig test lib/std/dynamic_library.sig` 0 passed/2 skipped/0 failed). DONE checks over -g "*.sig" lib src tools: check-1 (Elf(32|64)_[A-Za-z]) = 0; check-2 (elf.(SHT|SHF|STB|STT|STV|ELFCLASS|ELFDATA|EI)_[A-Z]) = 0; check-3 (.sh_/.st_*/.r_*/.d_* ELF fields) = 0 genuine hits (only SuperH .sh_interrupt/.sh_gnu/.sh_renesas remain, as expected). No /// Deprecated markers remain in lib/std/elf.sig. EXTRAS: `sig test compiler/test_all.sig` = All 224 tests passed. sBPF ET_DYN sanity-check (sig build-lib -target sbf-solana-solana) was UNAVAILABLE on this host: it fails inside the INSTALLED 0.6.1 toolchain stdlib (Io/Threaded.sig getrandom, posix.sig IOV_MAX missing for the sbf-solana platform) before reaching ELF emission -- unrelated to this migration (uses the installed stdlib, not the worktree). The byteSwap/serialization paths are instead covered by the GREEN compiler-graph type-check and the 224 passing compiler tests.
